name: TestBoard_ADC124 PZT front end
description: 7 PZT sensors (SM311) -> TMUX1308A 8:1 mux -> OPA365 buffer -> AIN_B4, with a VMID channel on S7. Charge-source sensor model, mux leakage / charge injection / capacitances, behavioral op-amp.

items.label: Width
items.tip: Electrode width. Cp = eps0*eps33*W*L/t.

items.label: Thickness
items.tip: Element thickness (0.25 mm confirmed).

items.label: Relative permittivity eps33T/eps0
items.tip: Steminc SM311: 3500 at 1 kHz.

items.label: d33 charge constant
items.tip: Steminc SM311: 600 pC/N.

items.label: Force gain
items.tip: Scales the applied force (sensitivity scatter, force coupling).

items.label: Insulation resistance
items.tip: DC leakage of the element (placeholder 10 Gohm).

items.label: Dielectric loss model
items.tip: none = ideal Cp. parallel_r = tan delta as a parallel resistor; it creates a DC leak that dominates ms-long baselines.

items.label: tan delta
items.tip: 2.5 % at 1 kHz (used when the loss model is parallel_r).

items.label: R13 bias resistor
items.tip: Op-amp + input to VMID. Sets how fast a sensor is pulled back to VMID.

items.label: Initial sensor node voltage
items.tip: Start condition of every sensor node.

items.label: Adjacent-pin coupling
items.tip: Source of channel-to-channel crosstalk.

items.label: On resistance
items.tip: Datasheet typ 120 ohm (max 330).

items.label: Ron signal dependence
items.tip: Ron *= 1 + k*(V-Vmid)^2

items.label: Source off capacitance
items.tip: typ 2 pF.

items.label: Drain off capacitance
items.tip: typ 7 pF.

items.label: On capacitance (lumped)
items.tip: typ 11 pF; the extra on-capacitance is c_on - cs_off - cd_off.

items.label: S-D feedthrough capacitance
items.tip: Derived from off isolation (-90 dB at 1 MHz).

items.label: Charge injection
items.tip: typ -0.8 pC at 3.3 V (charge delivered to D when a channel turns off).

items.label: Injection share to source side
items.tip: 0 = all to D.

items.label: Off-state S->D leakage per channel
items.tip: typ +/-1 nA at 25 C; 25 nA max at 85 C. Applied with the same sign on every channel.

items.label: Leakage multiplier
items.tip: Scales both leakage currents (temperature, spread).

items.label: Switch-on delay
items.tip: tTRAN typ 23 ns.

items.label: Control edge time
items.tip: Break-before-make needs on >= off + edge.

items.label: Scan order (MUX addresses)
items.tip: Comma separated addresses 0..6 (S0..S6). Each address once.

items.label: VMID visit after every sensor
items.tip: On: after each sensor the mux goes to VMID (settle + park) before the next sensor. Off: sensors follow each other directly and the mux parks on VMID once per sweep.

items.label: Start delay
items.tip: Time before the first address command.

system.group: MUX group and ADC (derives conversion time and the wait on the channel)

items.label: Repeats (conversions per channel)
items.tip: The ADC reads the same channel this many times in a row before the muxes switch to the next channel or VMID; only the last conversion is kept. Each extra repeat adds n_mux ADC words to the connected time.

items.label: Number of MUXs read per channel
items.tip: The board has 4 muxes. All switch together; the ADC reads them one after the other. The simulated mux is the first one read, so it waits (n - 1) ADC words on its channel before the muxes switch to the next channel.

items.label: ADC SPI clock
items.tip: Default 16 MHz (type 16meg). One ADC word = clocks per word / SPI clock = 1 us at 16 MHz.

items.label: SCLK clocks per ADC word
items.tip: ADC124S101: 16 clocks (3 acquisition + 13 conversion).

items.label: SCLK clocks of acquisition (track)
items.tip: ADC124S101: 3 clocks. The sample is held this long after the settle time.

system.group: Per-sensor timing (measured from the address command)

items.label: Sensor settle time (shared by all muxes)
items.tip: All muxes switch at the same time and share this wait before the ADC starts.

items.label: VMID settle time
items.tip: VMID-visit settle time after every sensor (only used when the VMID visit is on).

items.label: VMID park time
items.tip: Parked on VMID while other mux groups are sampled (placeholder). With a VMID visit after every sensor: after every address (following the VMID settle). Without it: once per sweep, after the last address. Ignored when a sampling rate is set.

items.label: Per-sensor sampling rate
items.tip: Optional per-sensor revisit rate. Empty = use the park time. When set, the VMID park time is derived so each sensor is revisited at this rate (error if too high).

items.label: Run duration
items.tip: Optional. Empty = use the number of scan cycles below. 60 ms at 5 ns takes ~4 minutes.

items.label: Scan cycles
items.tip: Used when no run duration is set.

items.label: Maximum time step
items.tip: 5 ns resolves the 2 ns charge-injection edges. Coarser steps are faster but give noisy baselines.

items.label: Periodic control from N cycles
items.tip: Runs with at least this many cycles use compact periodic control sources.

tables.title: Input profile: force pulses
tables.tip: One row per trapezoidal force pulse on a sensor. Rows on the same address add up. Amplitudes above ~0.17 N exceed the supply for a 0.7 mm sensor.

tables.title: Input profile: sine waves
tables.tip: One row per sinusoidal force on a sensor: F = amplitude x sin(2 pi f t) for the given number of cycles starting at Start (zero before and after, so it swings both ways around the VMID level). Rows on the same address add up and also add to the pulses above.
